definitions.ab: One fresh Node process per row. rep=1 covers 23 distinct problems per arm and runs checkers. Five problems have two further timed observations per arm. An absent checker result in a timing-only row means not requested.
definitions.h0/rss0/heap/peak: Bytes. h0 and rss0 after exposed GC before search; heap after GC with finished solver and report retained. Live heap growth is heap-h0. peak is process.resourceUsage().maxRSS * 1024 immediately after solve, before checkers. Includes process startup. ms is solveProblem including artifact generation.
definitions.slots: Resident frontier children. expanded is number with expanded flag at finish, independent of recursive calls. empty and nonEmpty count RZ references, not unique objects.
definitions.digest: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 lproofJson bytes. canonical is the checker compact projection.
definitions.queries: White SGF reply -> independent query replay result for this source on this sibling. PASS includes identity. LP-R03 excludes only this proof on this sibling. spent counts only cumulative isolated search calls, excluding replay/checker.
definitions.native: CLI wall time solveTotalMs includes solve, CLI verification and output. fileCheck uses independent CLI check --problem.
definitions.cross: Each [errorCode,canonicalDagChecksum] is for the indicated reader and writer with original_root and original problem binding.

reproduction.setup: Use a temporary checkout at the recorded commit. Place each harness string in its project root so ./src resolves. Bundle with esbuild --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs. For the A/B duplicate the A bundle and apply only the two hunks of compiledBundleDiff to B (generated symbol names may differ).
reproduction.ab: node --expose-gc A.cjs <catalog-id> verify 3500 and likewise B.cjs. First pass all 23 separately. Two further timing-only repeats for five problems, replacing verify with time. Interleave arms.
reproduction.conditional: Bundle conditionalHarness and execute with node; script computes its own slices, verifies each solved source and emits all residual sibling replays.
reproduction.native: cmake -S cpp -B <tmp-build> -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release; cmake --build <tmp-build>; ctest --test-dir <tmp-build> --output-on-failure. tprover solve --problem public/tsumego/<id>.json --mode <mode> --node-limit 3500 --max-depth 48 --memory-budget 512 --out-proof <tmp-file>; for proven files run tprover check --problem public/tsumego/<id>.json --proof <tmp-file>.
reproduction.cross: For p031 and p042, run crossHarness with node cross.cjs <id> verify 3500 <directory-containing-id-pattern-tt.json>; run the native checker with the original problem on the generated <id>-ts.json.
